sn47.17:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhākkhayāya || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhadomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa sammādukkhakkhayāyā ti || ||
